subject: Next steps — timeshare deep-dive pilot & rotating regional hubs
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novatech.com>
Cc: Lena Hoffman <lena@medialabs.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next step — timeshare deep-dive pilot

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the chat earlier. Quick recap from my side: Multiplex is focused on predictable inference latency for your mixed batch workloads (especially during overnight ETL bursts), and you want a short pilot to validate throughput, cost, and a live deep-dive with your infra team.

Proposed next step: a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive where we run a small live traffic replay and walk through the tight latency knobs (batching, KV cache, and quantization profile). You mentioned coverage across your US, EU, and APAC teams — to keep it light for engineers we typically rotate the deep-dive slot weekly so each region gets an equitable window.

I attached a small regional grid with candidate slots and a draft pilot SOW. Can you confirm: which personas you want on the call (infra, MLOps, security)? Also please pick any two of the candidate slots that work for your teams.

Attachments: regional-timeshare-grid.csv (candidate slots, local times), MAD_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf (draft scope + success metrics)

Thanks — happy to adjust cadence.

Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novatech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
Cc: Lena Hoffman <lena@medialabs.io>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 08:45:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Recap + next step — timeshare deep-dive pilot

Jonas —

Appreciate the recap. For attendees: infra lead (me), platform eng (Lena), and our MLOps owner (Rajiv Kumar) — I can loop Rajiv after we lock a time.

Availability (our local times):
- This week: Tue/Wed mornings IST (08:00–11:00 IST) — corresponds to Mon late-night US / Tue early EU
- Next week: Prefer a slot that alternates across regions — ideally we take one EU-friendly slot and one APAC-friendly slot across the pilot.

Quick preference: can we do a pilot rhythm where we run next three weekly deep-dives on alternating windows (Week 1: US-evening / EU-afternoon, Week 2: EU-morning / APAC-afternoon, Week 3: APAC-morning / US-afternoon)? If that matches your proposed grid, we can confirm.

Sanjay
VP Infrastructure, Multiplex Systems
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novatech.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 11:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next step — timeshare deep-dive pilot

Sanjay — great, that alignment works. Below is a concrete rotating proposal (keeps the same weekday/time zone mapping each week so calendars stay steady):

Proposed 3-week pilot rotation (all times shown with target local zone first, then UTC):
- Week A (US-centric window): Tue 17:00 PT / Wed 01:00 UTC — US evening, EU late afternoon
- Week B (EU-centric window): Tue 10:00 CET / Tue 09:00 UTC — EU morning, APAC afternoon
- Week C (APAC-centric window): Wed 09:30 IST / Wed 04:00 UTC — APAC morning, US early evening

We’ll run the same test plan each week (traffic replay + tuning pass) and capture latency/cost deltas. Team plan: Jonas (lead), Soojin (runtime tuning), Marissa (observability & evals).

Action items for you: confirm which week you prefer to start (A/B/C) and whether Rajiv will join Week 1. Once you confirm I’ll send calendar invites with timezone-aware blocks and a short agenda.

Also attaching a cleaned grid where I mapped those windows into Multiplex local timezones.

Thanks,
Jonas
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 01:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: availability mapping + who joins

Jonas / Marissa — forwarding Sanjay’s note to confirm internal attendance. Quick notes:
- I can take the Week B (EU-centric) slot if we start Week A next week — that gives me time to prep the runtime perf scripts.
- Marissa, can you own the dashboard ingest for Week A? We should capture token-level cost and p50/p95 latency.

Small ops ask: if Week A lands at Tue 17:00 PT that’s 20:00 ET — confirm whether legal/compliance needs to be cc’d for cross-border logs. If so we should add a short consent blurb to the invite.

Thanks — Soojin
